command: C:\Windows\System32\WindowsPowerShell\v1.0\powershell.exe -NoProfile -Command "`$nodes=@('AGG_SW_03','AGG_SW_04','Core_SW_01','Core_SW_02'); `$c='display current-configuration'; `$e=[System.Uri]::EscapeDataString(`$c); `$p='(description to_|stp |traffic|qos|bandwidth|speed|port access vlan|port trunk permit vlan|port link-type|port link-aggregation|link-aggregation|shutdown)'; foreach (`$n in `$nodes) { `$r=Invoke-RestMethod -Uri ('http://127.0.0.1:3080/v3/projects/CampusNetwork_06/nodes/'+`$n+'/command?cmd='+`$e); Write-Output ('===== NODE='+`$n+' ====='); (`$r.output -split '\r?\n') | Where-Object { `$_ -match `$p } }"
